description: Tests the accessibility toolbar options 'Increase Text' and 'High Contrast' to ensure they adjust the page appropriately for users with visual impairments.
steps: Locate the 'Increase Text' button using its stable selector.
Verify that the text size on the page increases.
Locate the 'High Contrast' button using its stable selector.
Verify that the page background and text colors switch to high-contrast mode.
Check that the buttons remain functional after applying the changes.
Verify that the changes persist across page reloads.
expected_results: Text size increases after clicking 'Increase Text'.
Page background and text colors change to high-contrast mode after clicking 'High Contrast'.
Accessibility changes persist across page reloads.
edge_cases: Buttons are disabled or not visible.
Page content fails to react to accessibility settings.
Changes cause layout distortions or broken elements.
Accessibility settings do not persist across page reloads.
Buttons trigger errors or fail silently.
data_requirements: Baseline text size and color scheme.
No conflicting browser extensions affecting accessibility.
dependencies: Buttons must be functional and clickable.
Browser must support CSS changes triggered by accessibility settings.
api_interactions: None, as these are frontend UI changes.
performance_metrics: Response time after clicking accessibility buttons.
Page render time after applying settings.
accessibility_requirements: Test screen reader compatibility with the buttons.
Verify ARIA roles and labels for the toolbar.
